paragraphs.text: 1. LET me win glory, Agni, in our battles: enkindling thee, may we support our bodies.
paragraphs.original: ममाग्ने वर्चो विहवेष्वस्तु वयं त्वेन्धानास्तन्वं पुषेम ।
paragraphs.translit: mamāgne varco vihaveṣvastu vayaṃ tvendhānāstanvaṃ puṣema |

paragraphs.text: May the four regions bend and bow before me: with thee for guardian may we win in combat.
2. May all the Gods be on my side in battle, the Maruts led by Indra, Visnu, Agni.
paragraphs.original: मम देवा विहवे सन्तु सर्व इन्द्रवन्तो मरुतो विष्णुरग्निः ।
paragraphs.translit: mama devā vihave santu sarva indravanto maruto viṣṇuragniḥ |

paragraphs.text: Mine be the middle air's extended region, and may the wind blow favouring these my wishes.
paragraphs.original: ममान्तरिक्षमुरुलोकमस्तु मह्यं वातः पवतां कामे अस्मिन्
paragraphs.translit: mamāntarikṣamurulokamastu mahyaṃ vātaḥ pavatāṃ kāme asmin

paragraphs.text: 3. May the Gods grant me riches; may the blessing and invocation of the Gods assist me.
paragraphs.original: मयि देवा द्रविणमा यजन्तां मय्याशीरस्तु मयि देवहूतिः ।
paragraphs.translit: mayi devā draviṇamā yajantāṃ mayyāśīrastu mayi devahūtiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Foremost in fight be the divine Invokers: may we, unwounded, have brave heroes round us.
paragraphs.original: दैव्या होतारो वनुषन्त पूर्वेऽरिष्टाः स्याम तन्वा सुवीराः
paragraphs.translit: daivyā hotāro vanuṣanta pūrve'riṣṭāḥ syāma tanvā suvīrāḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. For me let them present all mine oblations, and let my mind's intention be accomplished.
paragraphs.original: मह्यं यजन्तु मम यानि हव्याकूतिः सत्या मनसो मे अस्तु ।
paragraphs.translit: mahyaṃ yajantu mama yāni havyākūtiḥ satyā manaso me astu |

paragraphs.text: May I he guiltless of the least transgression: and, all ye Go-is, do ye combine to bless us.
paragraphs.original: एनो मा नि गां कतमच्चनाहं विश्वे देवासो अधि वोचता नः
paragraphs.translit: eno mā ni gāṃ katamaccanāhaṃ viśve devāso adhi vocatā naḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Ye six divine Expanses, grant us freedom: here, all ye Gods, acquit yourselves like heroes.
paragraphs.original: देवीः षळुर्वीरुरु नः कृणोत विश्वे देवास इह वीरयध्वम् ।
paragraphs.translit: devīḥ ṣaḷurvīruru naḥ kṛṇota viśve devāsa iha vīrayadhvam |

paragraphs.text: Let us not lose our children or our bodies: let us not benefit the foe, King Soma!
paragraphs.original: मा हास्महि प्रजया मा तनूभिर्मा रधाम द्विषते सोम राजन्
paragraphs.translit: mā hāsmahi prajayā mā tanūbhirmā radhāma dviṣate soma rājan

paragraphs.text: 6. Baffling the wrath of our opponents, Agni, guard us as our infallible Protector.
paragraphs.original: अग्ने मन्युं प्रतिनुदन्परेषामदब्धो गोपाः परि पाहि नस्त्वम् ।
paragraphs.translit: agne manyuṃ pratinudanpareṣāmadabdho gopāḥ pari pāhi nastvam |

paragraphs.text: Let these thy foes turn back and seek their houses, and let their thought who watch at home be ruined.
paragraphs.original: प्रत्यञ्चो यन्तु निगुतः पुनस्तेऽमैषां चित्तं प्रबुधां वि नेशत्
paragraphs.translit: pratyañco yantu nigutaḥ punaste'maiṣāṃ cittaṃ prabudhāṃ vi neśat

paragraphs.text: 7. Lord of the world, Creator of creators the saviour God who overcomes the foeman.
May Gods, Brhaspati, both Asvins shelter from ill this sacrifice and sacrificer.
paragraphs.original: इमं यज्ञमश्विनोभा बृहस्पतिर्देवाः पान्तु यजमानं न्यर्थात्
paragraphs.translit: imaṃ yajñamaśvinobhā bṛhaspatirdevāḥ pāntu yajamānaṃ nyarthāt

paragraphs.text: 8. Foodful, and much-invoked, at this our calling may the great Bull vouchsafe us wide protection.
paragraphs.original: उरुव्यचा नो महिषः शर्म यंसदस्मिन्हवे पुरुहूतः पुरुक्षुः ।
paragraphs.translit: uruvyacā no mahiṣaḥ śarma yaṃsadasminhave puruhūtaḥ purukṣuḥ |

paragraphs.text: Lord of Bay Coursers, Indra, blew our children: harm us not, give us riot as prey to others.
paragraphs.original: स नः प्रजायै हर्यश्व मृळयेन्द्र मा नो रीरिषो मा परा दाः
paragraphs.translit: sa naḥ prajāyai haryaśva mṛḷayendra mā no rīriṣo mā parā dāḥ

paragraphs.text: 9. Let those who are our foemen stay. afar from us: with Indra and with Agni we will drive them off.
paragraphs.original: ये नः सपत्ना अप ते भवन्त्विन्द्राग्निभ्यामव बाधामहे तान् ।
paragraphs.translit: ye naḥ sapatnā apa te bhavantvindrāgnibhyāmava bādhāmahe tān |

paragraphs.text: Vasus, Adityas, Rudras have exalted me, made me far-reaching, mighty, thinker, sovran lord.
paragraphs.original: वसवो रुद्रा आदित्या उपरिस्पृशं मोग्रं चेत्तारमधिराजमक्रन्
paragraphs.translit: vasavo rudrā ādityā uparispṛśaṃ mograṃ cettāramadhirājamakran
